name: orangehrm-playwright
description: Playwright TypeScript automation for OrangeHRM demo

scripts.test:launch: playwright test -g "should launch the website and open the login page"
scripts.test:valid-login: playwright test -g "should login successfully with valid credentials"
scripts.test:invalid-login: playwright test -g "should show error for invalid credentials"
scripts.test:empty-credentials: playwright test -g "should show required field validation when credentials are empty"
scripts.test:forgot-password: playwright test -g "should navigate to forgot password page"
